_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil statistics dominate: neutral momentum/funding, dead flows, and almost no recent score travel make HOLD the graded base-rate call until a named breaker appears.
next_move.brains_agree: Yes on current Anxiety and non-directional stance; narrative has no distinct forward call to split against the analyst HOLD
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays rangebound, fear/greed ~30-45, and 30d momentum factor remains near 50
next_move.invalidated_if: Momentum factor breaks toward mid-30s with fear/greed ~20, or a squeeze lifts momentum and ETF flows together and pushes the score up a rung
